factual_claims.source_evidence: CET1 capital ratio %: 14.15% (2025); Capital adequacy ratio %: 18.54% (2025) (Capitalisation and risk positions table, page 17)

factual_claims.claim: The bank continued its dividend policy by paying 0.07 euros per share, totaling 7.2 million euros to shareholders.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: On May 6, 2025, Coop Pank paid a dividend of 0.07 euros (net) per share from the profit earned in 2024, in the total net amount of 7,209 thousand euros. (Dividend policy section, page 24)

factual_claims.claim: Management expects to return to net profit growth in 2026 as the economic recovery gains momentum, although the immediate impact of new investments is anticipated to materialize in the second half of 2026 and early 2027.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: While we anticipated net profit decline in 2024 and 2025, our goal is to return to net profit growth in 2026... the larger positive effect of these investments on the economy will only become more evident in the second half of 2026 and the first half of 2027. (Managing Director´s Statement, page 10)

factual_claims.claim: The credit rating agency Moody’s affirmed Coop Pank’s deposit rating at Baa2 with a positive outlook, citing strong profitability, solid capitalization, and a high-quality credit portfolio.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: In 2025, the credit rating agency Moody’s affirmed Coop Pank’s deposit rating at Baa2 with a positive outlook. The confirmation of both the rating and the positive outlook indicates that Coop Pank remains a reliable bank with strong profitability, solid capitalization, and a high-quality credit portfolio. (Managing Director´s Statement, page 11)
